blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified (see the header): seeded donor pick + type graft + a ledger shared with two engine hooks (opponent switch-in, leave field) that find the attr by constructor name. The trigger is a separate WHEN and there is no condition in the class. Constructor change (behaviour-neutral, spec 3.1 spirit): the ctor now takes sourceMemberCount (default BAD_SPLICE_CONFIG.sourceMemberCount = 1) and the opponent-summon half reads it from the holder's live attr, so a rebuilt rule with another count also changes the later splices. Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) the ledger is only cleared when the holder leaves the field, so a holder whose ability is later suppressed keeps its grafts while it stays out (the later-switch-in half stops, because hasBadSplice-style lookup reads active attrs); (2) a foe that was spliced and then faints or leaves keeps a stale ledger entry until the holder leaves (harmless, WeakMap keyed by the holder). Requested nothing from the library for this class.

blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified (see the header). 1 attr in 1 ability: Borrowed Time (5910 attr 0). The ability is TWO attrs that share a WeakMap: this entry half and BorrowedTimeDecayAbAttr (attr 1); a rule that uses only one half does nothing useful. Constructor change (behaviour-neutral): the ctor takes decayTurns (default BORROWED_TIME_DECAY_TURNS = 3) and the state remembers it (a new `turns` field), so the decay half and applyDecay follow the number; 3 gives the original arithmetic exactly (diff * remaining / 3). decayTurns must be at least 1 (0 would divide by zero). The swapped stat (Speed) is fixed: the partner is chosen by Speed too, so it is not a free param. Suspected oddity, NOT fixed: the source comment says ties are broken by battler index, but the strict `>` in reduce keeps the first foe in getOpponents() order, which is the same only when that order is the battler order. Another: the swap writes the permanent stat, and a foe that leaves the field keeps decaying off-field by design (documented in the header of borrowed-time.ts).

blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified. 1 attr in 1 ability: Cleansing Light (5912 attr 0). The trigger (WHEN event.on-win, which fires once per KO the holder scores) is a separate swappable block and the class has no condition of its own beyond the living-ally feasibility, which is the effect's target and stays in the class. The effect cannot be split with the current library because (1) the target is 'the ally with the lowest HP' and effect.heal-percent / effect.cure-status can only target the holder, the other Pokemon or a side, and (2) the rider depends on how many KOs the holder scored THIS TURN, a per-turn counter (module WeakMap keyed by holder with a wave:turn key) that the library has no atom for (time.nth-use counts per battle). Requests R-B15-9 (target 'my weakest ally') and R-B15-10 (atom 'KOs I scored this turn') would let it become WHEN + heal-percent + (IF kos >= 2) cure-status. Both numbers (heal share, KO number that starts the cure) are typed params. State: erCleansingLightKoState is read by the AI snapshot (ai/combat-private-state.ts), so the WeakMap stays as it is. Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) the KO counter only runs when canApply found a living ally, so a KO scored while no ally stands does not count toward 'second KO this turn' (and the `if (!ally)` branch after the bump can never be reached); (2) the status cure message is a hard-coded English string, not an i18n key; (3) the heal message reuses the 'postTurnHeal' text.

blocks.packageReason: Tier B, PACKAGE for the effect only. 1 attr in 1 ability: Dandelion Burst (5907 attr 0). The trigger (after taking damage), the crossing condition (hp.crossed-below, floor-half, ratio param linked by gateParams) and the not-fainted guard are separate blocks; the effect does two things per foe in one loop (plant Leech Seed with the source move Leech Seed, and a stat-stage phase). Why the effect is a package: effect.apply-tag is not implemented in the library, so the seeding cannot be an existing block; the stat half could be effect.stat-stage on the opposing side but the two are interleaved per foe in one loop and splitting them would change phase order for several foes (see requests R-B15-8). The Leech Seed tag and its source move are fixed (the pair SEEDED + Leech Seed); stat and stages are typed params. LEGACY part: the once-per-battle memory (clause 2) is the ability's own WeakMap keyed by holder with the wave index as value, which the AI snapshot also reads (erDandelionBurstUsedWave); library time.once-per (wave scope) uses waveData.entryEffectsFired, a different memory, and adding a key there would change the AI state, so clause 2 stays in guards() and is listed as feasibility until the librarian adds a scope that can share a caller-owned memory (R-B15-7). Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) Cotton Spore is modelled as a Speed drop to EACH active foe (by design, documented in the source), (2) a foe's stat-stage phase is queued even when the Leech Seed tag was refused (Grass type), by design; (3) the once-per mark is written before any foe is acted on, so a holder whose foes all faint in the loop still uses it up.

blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified. 1 attr in 1 ability: Draconic Voodoo (5930 attr 0). The entry trigger is a separate swappable WHEN and the class has no condition, so nothing is hidden. The effect cannot be split because the library has no 'add a type to a Pokemon' effect (the graft substrate with its wave-end expiry and its message), see request R-B15-4 (the same graft effect Bad Splice needs). The second half of the ability (graft on a damaging biting or same-type hit) lives in the engine's hit seam (batch4-on-hit.ts), found by constructor name; it needs a WHEN 'when my attack damages a target' that the library lacks and a printed-flag atom (biting uses move.hasFlag), requests R-B15-12 (the moment) and R-B15-6 (the flag atom). The only setting is the type (typed, default Dragon), shared by both halves. Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) the on-hit half tests the PRINTED biting flag while most flag consumers use doesFlagEffectApply; (2) the entry half targets one foe only (across, else first), the on-hit half any damaged target, which matches the ability text; (3) a foe that is Tera Dragon counts as already Dragon (isOfType) and is skipped silently.

blocks.packageReason: PACKAGE, justified. 1 attr in 1 ability: Heartbreak (5920 attr 0). The entry trigger is a separate swappable WHEN and the class has no condition. The effect is a soul link plus a faint reaction: the library has no 'link two Pokemon' effect (state in link.ts, broken when either leaves) and no moment 'when my linked ally faints' (the reaction is driven from FaintPhase, found by constructor name), see request R-B15-13. Suspected oddities, NOT fixed: (1) the pick compares RAW stats (getStat) while the comparable Berserk archetype compares getEffectiveStat, so stat stages are ignored here; (2) the link is read raw at faint time without the both-on-field gate, so a holder that already left the field cannot react (hasHeartbreak requires isActive), which is intended; (3) formLink skips allies that are already linked, so two Heartbreak holders in a triple battle can leave one unlinked.
